finding.headline: Spin-boson trajectories produce exactly 2 evidence-graph signatures under the spectral_retrieval pipeline; lambda=500 (strong system-bath coupling) is the deterministic discriminator.

discriminator_rule.name: lambda=500 forces (11,46) signature; sig (11,46) is exclusively lambda=500
discriminator_rule.rule: Of 312 lambda=500 trajectories, 214 (68.6%) land in (11, 46). Of all 214 (11, 46) trajectories, 100% have lambda=500.
discriminator_rule.derivation: Cross-tab of evidence-graph (n_nodes, n_edges) vs lambda over all 1560 twobath trajectories. The sig_11_46_with_lambda_500_pct = 100% is the load-bearing claim (perfect specificity); the lambda_500_to_sig_11_46_pct = 68.6% is the partial sensitivity (lambda=500 is necessary but not sufficient for the +1-edge signature).

gamma_observation.name: gamma=500 (strong damping) never appears in (11, 46)
gamma_observation.rule: Strong damping keeps trajectories in the (11, 45) majority regardless of lambda.

temperature_observation.name: Tavg span 77 to 500 produces no new signatures
temperature_observation.rule: Extending Tavg from 150-300 (recovered set) to 77-500 (full set) brings no new evidence-graph signatures. The pipeline's binary discriminator is purely about coupling regime (lambda), not temperature.

saturation_observation.name: Both signatures hit the 11-node FAISS retrieval cap
saturation_observation.rule: n_nodes=11 is the FAISS retrieval top_k cap used by the spectral_retrieval pipeline. Quantum trajectories saturate this cap with 45-46 edges among the 11 retrieved chunks. Markets winners saturate the same cap with 53 edges (denser cross-chunk relationships).

implications_for_od_engine: The 2-class signature taxonomy is a candidate INPUT FEATURE for any downstream classifier that distinguishes coupling regimes from raw density-matrix trajectories without re-running the spectral pipeline.

The +1 edge / -0.07 vp signature for lambda=500 is structural: any Lindblad recovery method that processes these trajectories should see corresponding signal in its eigenvalue spectrum or relaxation timescales.
Initial state (exc/sup) is balanced within each signature class — it does NOT discriminate at the pipeline level. Any features that depend on initial-state purity should be checked separately.
The n=1498 sample is bounded to twobath naming convention. If qd3set trajectories become available, re-run and check whether they introduce new signatures or fall into the existing 2-class taxonomy.
